scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/generate-sw.mjs && node scripts/check-credentials.mjs --dist
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-where-i-left-off --only firestore "env TEST_SUITE=security vitest run"
scripts.test:e2e: VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true VITE_TEST_OFFLINE=true vite build && node scripts/generate-sw.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-where-i-left-off --only auth,firestore "playwright test"
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e && VITE_USE_EMULATORS=false npm run build
scripts.test:e2e:failed: VITE_USE_EMULATORS=true VITE_TEST_OFFLINE=true vite build && node scripts/generate-sw.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-where-i-left-off --only auth,firestore "playwright test --last-failed --max-failures=1"
